## Notes for the coordinator

- No lane edits a production file in an r10b scope or an open PR (as of generation). Test lanes add new test files; only T33/T34 touch workflows, and T34 edits api-test-coverage.yml on one line after T33.
- Newman lanes need a PostgreSQL-backed Nextcloud; boot-nextcloud.sh was verified to boot on SQLite here, where OpenRegister cannot store objects. The PostgreSQL path is unverified in the cloud sandbox: each Newman lane probes it and otherwise relies on the PR's CI Newman job, read once.
- On the base commit both Newman runners and the PHPUnit cells were red on development (3 Newman assertion failures; in-container unit step failing). New collections run in the same job, so lanes read their own collection's section, not the job verdict.
- The mutation lane T37 runs on its access lanes' files as they merge; it can start at once on the merged part.
